## Code Review Findings

**Files reviewed**: 6 files, including candidate and historical versions; 10 lines changed across 2 files (+5/−5)  
**Active profiles**: python  
**Overall assessment**: APPROVE  
**Intent and scope**: README-authorized `Items` → `Records` label change, preserving counts, calculations, mode selection and mean suffix. Reviewed captured index diff only; no feature task scope supplied. All eight supplied instruction/checklist files loaded before evidence.  
**Baselines**: Repository `/tmp/fr-advisory-bootstrap-20261018/codex-candidate-R6D-isolated-1`; review base `2b50e59ae84150f97d5c6822cb9d23d9fc911a3b`; candidate captured index. No deployed baseline asserted.

### Behavior and Compatibility

**Supported:** The diff changes only the label in [formatting.py](/tmp/kk-batch-review-jbq39peh/candidate/formatting.py:2) and four expected strings in [tests/test_report.py](/tmp/kk-batch-review-jbq39peh/candidate/tests/test_report.py:6). This satisfies the [README contract](/tmp/kk-batch-review-jbq39peh/candidate/README.md:5).

Inspected all six original paths: `README.md`, `formatting.py`, `tests/test_report.py`, `app.py`, `stats.py`, and `config.py`, in both snapshots.

| Scenario | Candidate result and compatibility |
|---|---|
| Empty plain batch | `Records: 0`; count preserved. |
| `[2, 4]`, plain mode | `Records: 2`; arithmetic unchanged. |
| `[2, 4]`, detailed mode | `Records: 2; Mean: 3`; mean calculation and `g` formatting preserved. |
| Omitted mode | Uses checked-in `False`; produces plain output. |
| Explicit Boolean | Continues to override the default. |
| Empty detailed batch | Same `ZeroDivisionError` before and after; inherited behavior, without increased reachability. |

Historical comparisons use the named repository/base above: [app.py](/tmp/kk-batch-review-jbq39peh/historical/app.py:6), lines 6–10; [stats.py](/tmp/kk-batch-review-jbq39peh/historical/stats.py:1), lines 1–5; [formatting.py](/tmp/kk-batch-review-jbq39peh/historical/formatting.py:1), lines 1–9; and [config.py](/tmp/kk-batch-review-jbq39peh/historical/config.py:1). No introduced or worsened defect was established.

Parent reports all four tests passing in both snapshots, plus 36 paired comparisons covering empty/populated inputs, both defaults and all mode selections. Returned strings differed only by the required label; exceptions matched. These are attributed execution results; I did not run tests.

**Not applicable:** Schema migration, dependency changes and mixed-provider rollout; this increment changes presentation text only.
